An editorial illustration depicts the head and torso of a man in profile, facing right. He wears a black peaked cap and a tan collared garment with a black tie. His face and neck are rendered in tan, white, and black tones with sharp, angular shadows. A red, dripping shape appears on his neck, and a similar red stain marks his left shoulder.

The background is a textured, mottled beige and brown surface. Large red capital letters spelling "TEMPO" span the top center. Below this, smaller black text reads "EDISI 12-18 NOVEMBER 2012". To the right, red and black text reads "SOEDIRMAN SEORANG PANGLIMA, SEORANG MARTIR" above the red words "LAPORAN KHUSUS." A small white circle in the lower right contains the text "POSTER INFOGRAFIS BLITZKRIEG VS GERILYA." 

The top edge features white text: "DI BALIK AUDIT HAMBALANG | LAPORAN TEMPO DARI SURIAH." In the bottom left, a barcode, number "00037," "RP 29.700," a website address, and other small text are visible. The man’s gaze is directed upward and to the right.
